clusters.name: paste-burst-state-machine
clusters.executionModeRationale: This story rewrites the core classifier/buffer semantics that every later composer integration story depends on. It must run first and serially because the same file owns the timing invariants and unit tests.

clusters.name: composer-integration-tests
clusters.executionModeRationale: Composer behavior depends on the new state-machine API and shares the same tests around Enter suppression, redraw scheduling, and explicit paste handling, so it should not run in parallel with US-001.

clusters.name: patch-surface-and-verification
clusters.executionModeRationale: Documentation and invariant registration can only be accurate after the implementation seam and test names are known. It should run last and validate that every upstream-canonical edit has a SANDBOX PATCH marker or documented reason.
